overrides.replacement_claim: Sprint summaries, the performance status API, TUI, and server-rendered workbench bypass durable-run enrichment, leaving operational lifecycle and cancellation state empty even when a correlated durable run exists.
overrides.reason: Both theories describe the same projection defect. The aggregate summary uses the raw performance projection, the API returns that aggregate value, and the presentation surfaces consume operational fields that this path does not enrich.

overrides.replacement_claim: The performance evidence endpoint has a compatibility path that returns an unversioned ad hoc artifact payload instead of the schema-versioned PerformanceEvidenceResult DTO.
overrides.reason: The handler explicitly emits an ad hoc map without schema_version, records, or next_cursor when the optional evidence-query capability is absent.

overrides.replacement_claim: The public performance configuration table documents hard maxima above the built-in defaults even though validation rejects every value above its built-in default, causing documented supported values to fail configuration loading.
overrides.reason: The documented maxima exceed defaults for multiple fields, while validation consistently uses defaults as ceilings.

overrides.replacement_claim: PerformanceResult returns an unclassified raw error when no terminal result exists, bypassing performance-specific transport error mapping.
overrides.reason: The unavailable-result branch returns a plain error, while the HTTP performance mapping recognizes only the typed performance use-case error.

overrides.replacement_claim: The shared operation runner discards errors from performanceSettings, allowing runner construction and operation dispatch to proceed without propagating invalid performance configuration.
overrides.reason: Both theories identify the same discarded setup error. The assignment explicitly ignores an error that can represent duration parsing or limit validation failure, and no supplied evidence establishes a mandatory equivalent guard at this runner boundary.

overrides.replacement_claim: The performance CLI collapses every classified non-cancellation performance failure into the validation exit class, so configuration, runtime, timeout, dependency, and persistence failures do not retain appropriate CLI exit behavior.
overrides.reason: The CLI maps cancellation separately but unconditionally wraps all other performance errors with ExitValidation.

overrides.replacement_claim: The performance failure-finalization path can publish a stale writer's flow-state summary because it does not recheck the verification writer fence immediately before SaveFlowState.
overrides.reason: Both theories describe the same fencing gap. The failure path performs a fenced state publication and subsequently saves flow state without another ownership check, unlike the cited success path.

overrides.replacement_claim: ValidateRepairReverification accepts persisted performance reverification records whose nested target results contain invalid performance outcomes or malformed target data because it validates only top-level performance fields and never validates TargetResults.
overrides.reason: The persisted record includes TargetResults, but the supplied complete validation branch does not inspect those entries before succeeding.

overrides.replacement_claim: The JSON performance-output parser accepts malformed trailing content after an otherwise valid envelope because it rejects only a second decode that succeeds; any non-EOF decoding error is treated as acceptable trailing data.
overrides.reason: The second decode is not required to return EOF, so malformed trailing syntax produces a non-nil error that the parser accepts.

overrides.replacement_claim: The supplied requirements permit bounded public evidence references and do not establish that artifact-relative paths or digests are forbidden from the evidence metadata response.
overrides.reason: The frozen documentation explicitly promises bounded evidence references and describes public DTO references. The cited error contract does not prohibit exposing metadata paths or digests, and no supplied evidence shows these fields contain raw output, secrets, or an escaping private filesystem path.

overrides.replacement_claim: The TUI exposes mutating performance actions for a disabled project when a historical performance attempt exists.
overrides.reason: The navigation condition admits either enabled policy or an existing attempt, then adds start unconditionally and resume, cancel, and recover whenever the attempt ID is present.

overrides.replacement_claim: Requirements validation falsely reports a performance policy mismatch for fenced or HTML-commented pseudo Performance Targets headings when performance policy is disabled.
overrides.reason: Both theories describe the same inconsistent declaration detection. Target parsing excludes fenced and commented pseudo-sections, while the separate heading-presence check does not apply those exclusions before emitting the disabled-policy mismatch.

overrides.replacement_claim: Performance manifest discovery accepts descriptor markers separated from a function declaration by blank lines or additional comments, despite requiring the marker to immediately precede the function.
overrides.reason: The pending-marker logic explicitly continues across blank and comment lines, contradicting the immediate-precedence rule in the same source.

overrides.replacement_claim: Performance-specific defaults and lower-only validation are implemented in the generic platform config package, violating the requirement that product defaults and bounded-context validation remain in the owning product module.
overrides.reason: The platform package defines performance-domain defaults and policy validation, while the architecture criterion explicitly reserves product defaults and validation rules for the owning product module.

issues.claim: Pseudo Performance Targets headings inside fences or comments trigger disabled-policy mismatch findings.
issues.title: Policy validation mistakes pseudo target headings for declarations
issues.reason: Declaration detection does not share the parser's fence and comment exclusions.

issues.claim: Persisted repair performance reverification accepts malformed nested target results.
issues.title: Repair reverification omits nested performance validation
issues.reason: Only top-level authority fields are validated; target identities and comparison outcomes are trusted unchecked.

issues.claim: The unavailable performance-result error bypasses performance-specific classification and HTTP mapping.
issues.title: Unavailable performance result is returned unclassified
issues.reason: The raw error is not converted to the typed performance use-case error expected by the transport mapper.

issues.claim: Documented performance hard maxima above defaults are rejected by runtime validation.
issues.title: Performance limit documentation contradicts validation
issues.reason: Operators are told that values up to the listed hard maxima are supported, but values above defaults fail loading.

issues.claim: The evidence endpoint can return an unversioned fallback shape instead of PerformanceEvidenceResult.
issues.title: Evidence API has an incompatible fallback schema
issues.reason: A supported optional-capability branch emits different unversioned fields from the documented schema-versioned DTO.

issues.claim: Historical attempts cause the TUI to show mutating performance actions even when policy is disabled.
issues.title: Disabled projects expose historical performance mutations in TUI
issues.reason: The attempt-presence branch bypasses policy gating for start, resume, cancel, and recover navigation actions.

issues.claim: Descriptor discovery permits blank or comment lines between a marker and its function.
issues.title: Descriptor markers need not immediately precede functions
issues.reason: The parser retains pending marker state across intervening blank and comment lines despite the closed marker contract.

issues.claim: Failure finalization saves flow state without an immediate verification-writer fence check.
issues.title: Stale performance writer can publish flow summary
issues.reason: Ownership can be lost after fenced performance-state publication and before the unfenced flow-state save.

issues.claim: The generic platform configuration package owns performance product defaults and policy validation.
issues.title: Performance product policy is embedded in platform config
issues.reason: Bounded-context defaults and lower-only workflow policy reside in a package required to remain domain-neutral.

issues.claim: All non-cancellation performance failures are mapped to the validation CLI exit class.
issues.title: Performance CLI loses failure-specific exit behavior
issues.reason: Runtime, timeout, dependency, persistence, and configuration errors become indistinguishable from validation failures at the CLI boundary.

issues.claim: Aggregate performance projections bypass durable-run enrichment, so lifecycle and cancellation facts are absent from the status API, TUI, and workbench.
issues.title: Performance summaries omit durable lifecycle state
issues.reason: The aggregate summary path uses the raw state projection rather than the status use case that consults durable run control.

issues.claim: Malformed trailing JSON after a valid performance envelope is accepted.
issues.title: Performance JSON parser does not require EOF
issues.reason: Any second-decode error is accepted rather than only io.EOF.

issues.claim: The shared operation runner ignores performance configuration parsing and validation errors.
issues.title: Operation runner discards fatal performance configuration errors
issues.reason: A known setup failure disappears at runner construction rather than stopping operation dispatch.
